senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="N00366">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 5:27">Targ. Is. V, 27</cite>; a. e.—Part. <cite ref="N00019"><he>נָאִים</he></cite>, <he>נָיֵים</he>, <cite ref="N00669"><he>נָיֵם</he></cite>.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 121:3">Targ. Ps. CXXI, 3</cite>, sq. <he>ינום</he> Ms. (ed. <cite ref="N00669"><he>נָיֵם</he></cite>, <cite ref="N00019"><he>נאים</he></cite>).—

<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:14">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>לא בעי מר מֵינַם פורתא</he> would you not take a little nap? <cite ref="Eruvin 65a:14">Ib.</cite> <he>השתא … ונֵינוּם טובא</he> soon will come the days which are long and yet short (of deeds), when we shall have a long sleep.
<cite ref="Pesachim 120b:3">Pes. 120ᵇ</cite> <he>מינם קא נאים מר</he> were you asleep?, v. infra.

<cite ref="Yevamot 24b">Yeb. 24ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כי ניים ושכיב וכ׳</he> Rab must have said so when he was sleepy and going to bed; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 47b">B. Kam. 47ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 65a">65ᵃ</cite> (Ms. M. <cite ref="C00028"><he>גאני</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="C01132"><he>גְּנֵי</he></cite>).

senses.gloss: to be drowsy; to doze. Pes. l. c. אין נַמְנוּמֵי קא מְנַמְנְמִי Ms. O. (ed. incorr., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90) no, I was dozing.
units: Kidd. 17ᵇ, v. הֵינוּמָא.—Esp. to be in a comatose condition, be dying.
<cite ref="Moed Katan 28a:17">M. Kat. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>דהוה קא מְנַמְנֵם</he> that he was dying.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 72a:9">Kidd. 72ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>כי הוה קא מנ׳ רבי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ניחא נפשיה</he>) when Rabbi was dying.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 76:6">Targ. Ps. LXXVI, 6</cite>.—Y. Yeb. I, 3ᵃ bot. <he>שריין מִתְנַמְנְמִין</he> they began to be drowsy. Y. Meg. II, 73ᵃ bot.; a. fr.
